integrity: Analytic proof including determinant positivity, a sharp realizable rank bound, and all-dimension factorial coefficient. Supporting exact-rational and high-precision finite-dimensional tests do not certify infinite theorems. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real dissipative drifts with stationary Gaussian covariance normalized to identity; Schatten asymptotics on inverse Gaussian L2 only. Generic second-quantization and Gramian tools are credited; possible older equivalent formulations remain a priority risk. Only the dimension-at-least-three graded rank-sharp statement is asserted as new.
title: Kalman-graded Schatten blow-up and sharp rank bounds for inverse Gaussian semigroups
